# Lisbon Family Trip Plan: 7 Relaxed Days

A calm, family-friendly Lisbon itinerary for **2 adults + 2 kids (8, 11)** from **2026-04-10 to 2026-04-17**, built to stay within **€3,200 total excluding international flights**.
Pace is kept light: **no more than 2 activities per day**, with one beach day and plenty of scenic walking, museums, and easy transit.

## Day-by-Day Lisbon Itinerary and Budget

| Day | Plan | Transit | Est. Cost |
|---|---|---|---|
| Day 1 — Fri, Apr 10 | Arrive, settle in, easy Baixa/Chiado stroll | Airport metro/taxi to central lodging; walk | €220 |
| Day 2 — Sat, Apr 11 | Alfama + Sé area + viewpoint loop | Tram/metro + walking | €340 |
| Day 3 — Sun, Apr 12 | Museu Nacional do Azulejo + Parque das Nações riverside | Metro + short taxi if needed | €300 |
| Day 4 — Mon, Apr 13 | Belém museum day + riverside walk | Tram/Bus/ride-hail | €360 |
| Day 5 — Tue, Apr 14 | Beach day in Cascais or Carcavelos | Train from Cais do Sodré | €380 |
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/3/3c/Beach_near_Lisbon_Portugal%2C_1994..jpg Alt=| Day 5 — Tue, Apr 14 | Beach day in Cascais or Carcavelos | Train from Cais do Sodré | €380 |, Lisbon, Portugal
| Day 6 — Wed, Apr 15 | Calouste Gulbenkian Museum + Eduardo VII/Príncipe Real stroll | Metro + walk | €290 |
| Day 7 — Thu, Apr 16 | Free morning, souvenir shopping, sunset viewpoint | Walk + metro | €260 |

### Day 1: Arrival and Gentle City Center Walk
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/geo-alt.svg
- **Morning:** Arrive, check in, and rest.
- **Afternoon:** Easy walk through **Baixa** and **Chiado**; keep it short and flat.
- **Dinner:** Simple Portuguese meal near your hotel.
- **Transit:** Use **airport metro** if staying near a station; otherwise take a taxi or rideshare.
- **Estimated cost:** Lodging + local transit + casual meals: **€220**

Meal ideas:
- Pastéis de nata + fruit and yogurt for a light snack stop
- Grilled chicken with rice and fries
- Soup, bread, and a shared fish plate at a casual tasca

### Day 2: Alfama Views and Old Lisbon Streets
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/building.svg
- **Morning:** Explore **Alfama** slowly, starting near the cathedral area.
- **Afternoon:** Visit a viewpoint such as **Miradouro de Santa Luzia** and take a short scenic walk.
- **Dinner:** Family-friendly restaurant in Baixa or Alfama.
- **Transit:** Use **tram or metro** for the uphill parts; walk the rest.
- **Estimated cost:** Tickets, transit, lunch, dinner, snacks: **€340**

Meal ideas:
- Toasted ham and cheese sandwiches
- Grilled sardines or cod with potatoes
- Pizza or pasta as a kid-safe backup near the old town
Media: Alt=Pizza or pasta as a kid-safe backup near the old town, Lisbon, Portugal

### Day 3: Tile Museum and Riverside Time
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/book.svg
- **Morning:** **Museu Nacional do Azulejo** for a cultural stop that is manageable for kids.
- **Afternoon:** Head to **Parque das Nações** for an open-air riverside walk and playground break.
- **Dinner:** Casual meal near Oriente or back in the center.
- **Transit:** **Metro** is the easiest option; use a short taxi only if energy is low.
- **Estimated cost:** Museum entry, transit, lunch, dinner: **€300**

Meal ideas:
- Bakery sandwiches and juice
- Chicken piri-piri with rice
- Rice, soup, and grilled fish at a simple family restaurant

### Day 4: Belém Highlights
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/water.svg
- **Morning:** Choose one main museum or monument in **Belém**.
- **Afternoon:** Walk along the river and stop for pastries.
- **Dinner:** Return to central Lisbon for an easy dinner.
- **Transit:** **Tram 15 / bus / rideshare** depending on crowd levels.
- **Estimated cost:** Entry fees, transit, lunch, pastries, dinner: **€360**

Meal ideas:
- Famous custard tarts with milk or hot chocolate
- Soup and a sandwich lunch
- Grilled chicken or cod with potatoes for dinner

### Day 5: Beach Day in Cascais or Carcavelos
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/sun.svg
- **Morning:** Take the train to **Cascais** for a more scenic beach day, or **Carcavelos** for a simpler, closer option.
- **Afternoon:** Beach time, sand play, and a relaxed seaside lunch.
- **Dinner:** Seafood or pizza in Cascais, then return.
- **Transit:** **Train from Cais do Sodré** is the easiest family option.
- **Estimated cost:** Train, beach snacks, lunch, dinner, extras: **€380**

Meal ideas:
- Fruit, sandwiches, and bottled water for the beach
Media: Alt=Fruit, sandwiches, and bottled water for the beach, Lisbon, Portugal
- Grilled fish with fries
- Pizza, burgers, or pasta if the kids want something familiar

### Day 6: Museum Morning and Easy Park Walk
- **Morning:** **Calouste Gulbenkian Museum** for a quieter art visit.
- **Afternoon:** Relaxed walk in **Eduardo VII Park** or **Príncipe Real**.
Media: Alt=Afternoon:** Relaxed walk in **Eduardo VII Park** or **Príncipe Real**, Lisbon, Portugal
- **Dinner:** Low-key neighborhood dinner.
- **Transit:** **Metro** plus walking; very easy day.
- **Estimated cost:** Museum, transit, lunch, dinner, snacks: **€290**

Meal ideas:
- Café breakfast with pastries and juice
- Soup, salad, and a shared main dish
- Roast chicken or grilled meat with rice and vegetables

### Day 7: Souvenirs, Viewpoint, and Slow Finish
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/house.svg
- **Morning:** Sleep in, then do a short souvenir stop in **Chiado** or **Baixa**.
- **Afternoon:** One last viewpoint or riverside walk, then pack and rest.
- **Dinner:** Final family meal close to your lodging.
- **Transit:** Mostly **walking**, with metro if needed.
- **Estimated cost:** Shopping buffer, meals, transit: **€260**

Meal ideas:
- Bakery breakfast with pastries and fruit
- Simple lunch of soup, sandwich, or bifana
- Farewell dinner with grilled fish or chicken and shared sides

## Budget Fit and Best Transit Choices

### Family Budget Check
- **Target budget:** €3,200
- **Planned total:** about **€2,150–€2,350**
- **Estimated buffer left:** about **€850–€1,050**

What this covers comfortably:
- Mid-range family lodging
- Museum entries and local transit
- Casual meals with one nicer dinner or extra snack stops
- Beach day transport and food

### Transit Suggestions by Day
- **Airport to center:** metro if light luggage; taxi/rideshare if arriving tired
- **City center days:** walk first, metro second
- **Hill areas like Alfama:** use tram/metro to reduce uphill walking
- **Belém and Cascais:** train/tram is usually easiest and cheapest
- **With kids:** keep one “easy return to hotel” window each afternoon
